title: C. Río Duero 13, 6ºB
description: Bright three-bedroom apartment in Móstoles Sur with terrace, elevator, and easy access to public transport.

reviews.author: John Smith
reviews.comment: Great apartment, very well located and spacious rooms.

reviews.author: Antonio Jiménez
reviews.comment: It is well connected but very old. The floor creaks and the walls show signs of water damage.

title: Av. de la Constitución, 45
description: Modern two-bedroom shared apartment in central Madrid, ideal for students or young professionals.

reviews.author: Laura Martín
reviews.comment: Very good location and nice flatmates. The kitchen is a bit small.

title: C. Alcalá 120, 2ºC
description: Elegant four-bedroom residence in the Salamanca district with high ceilings and renovated bathrooms.

reviews.author: Carlos Ruiz
reviews.comment: Beautiful house, the bathrooms are brand new and the neighbourhood is very quiet.

reviews.author: Marta Gil
reviews.comment: Nice flat but too expensive for what it offers.

reviews.author: Pablo Herrera
reviews.comment: High ceilings and lots of light. Heating could be better.

title: Paseo de la Castellana 85
description: Cozy private room in Chamberí with study desk, built-in wardrobe, and shared modern kitchen.

reviews.author: Sofía Navarro
reviews.comment: Perfect room for studying, very clean and quiet.

title: C. Pintor Velázquez 12
description: Family-friendly three-bedroom flat near parks, supermarkets, and Rey Juan Carlos University.

reviews.author: David López
reviews.comment: Close to the university and the metro. Great for a family.

reviews.author: Elena Castro
reviews.comment: The landlord never answered when the heating broke.

title: Av. de España 5
description: Renovated two-bedroom shared flat in Fuenlabrada with air conditioning and balcony.

reviews.author: Javier Moreno
reviews.comment: Good price, but the building is a bit noisy at night.

reviews.author: Lucía Ortega
reviews.comment: The air conditioning is great in summer and the balcony is lovely.

title: C. Mayor 10, 3ºA
description: Spacious third-floor apartment in Alcorcón town center with natural gas heating and storage room.

reviews.author: Raúl Santos
reviews.comment: Very spacious and the storage room is really useful.

title: C. Princesa 31
description: Sunny shared apartment in Moncloa just minutes away from Ciudad Universitaria and Parque del Oeste.

reviews.author: Irene Vega
reviews.comment: I could walk to the faculty every day. Very sunny and bright.

reviews.author: Sergio Prieto
reviews.comment: Nice area but the rooms are tiny.

title: C. Gran Vía 12
description: Exterior private room on Gran Vía with soundproof windows, Wi-Fi, and weekly cleaning included.
